headline_marked: Messi scores 21st goal, but [[Inter Miami suffer stoppage-time defeat]]
headline: Messi scores 21st goal, but Inter Miami suffer stoppage-time defeat
summary: A brilliant free-kick from Lionel Messi wasn't enough to save Miami from a 2-1 loss to Columbus Crew in Major League Soccer.
details: Lionel Messi scored a stunning equalizer in the 33rd minute with a curled free-kick, bringing the score to 1-1 after Josef Martinez had put Columbus Crew ahead via a penalty.
Despite Messi's 21st goal of the regular season, Inter Miami struggled to maintain the lead and were frustrated by a strong Columbus defense.
Miami had a goal by David Ayala disallowed for offside, while Columbus nearly scored multiple times, including hitting the woodwork twice.
The match ended in a 2-1 victory for Columbus Crew after Jamal Thiare scored a close-range winner deep into stoppage time.
The defeat leaves Inter Miami trailing league leaders Nashville by 14 points with only seven games remaining in the regular season.
Columbus Crew, currently in 12th place, remain in the hunt for a playoff spot, moving to 29 points.
caption:
Messi's 21st goal of the season was not enough. A last-minute winner secures a victory for Columbus Crew.

Lionel Messi scored a stunning equalizer in the 33rd minute with a curled free-kick, bringing the score to 1-1 after Josef Martinez had put Columbus Crew ahead via a penalty.

Despite Messi's 21st goal of the regular season, Inter Miami struggled to maintain the lead and were frustrated by a strong Columbus defense.

Miami had a goal by David Ayala disallowed for offside, while Columbus nearly scored multiple times, including hitting the woodwork twice.

The match ended in a 2-1 victory for Columbus Crew after Jamal Thiare scored a close-range winner deep into stoppage time.

The defeat leaves Inter Miami trailing league leaders Nashville by 14 points with only seven games remaining in the regular season.

Columbus Crew, currently in 12th place, remain in the hunt for a playoff spot, moving to 29 points.

headline_marked: 5 killed as [[Russian drones strike Kyiv, Sumy, Kharkiv]]
headline: 5 killed as Russian drones strike Kyiv, Sumy, Kharkiv
summary: A wave of drone attacks across Ukraine killed at least five people and injured dozens, hitting markets, apartment buildings, and communications infrastructure.
details: Russian drones and glide bombs killed at least five people across Ukraine on Sunday, hitting civilian targets in Kyiv, Sumy, and Kharkiv.
In the western outskirts of Kyiv, a drone strike set a market in Sofiiska Borshchahivka ablaze, killing two people and injuring approximately 10 others.
Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported that nine people were injured in the capital, including a child, after drones hit high-rise apartments, a kindergarten, and a playground.
In the northern city of Sumy, three glide bombs struck near a family support centre, killing two people, while a drone strike in Kharkiv killed a driver in their car.
President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia deployed 277 attack drones since Saturday, including 155 jet-powered drones that are more difficult to intercept.
The attacks also targeted the headquarters of Ukraine's largest mobile service provider and the residence of the Saudi Arabian ambassador in Kyiv.
Russia's defence ministry claimed it struck two data centres in Kyiv and a logistics hub in Odesa, while both nations continue to deny targeting civilians.
caption:
5 people killed and dozens injured as Russia launches a massive wave of 277 drones across Ukraine.

Russian drones and glide bombs killed at least five people across Ukraine on Sunday, hitting civilian targets in Kyiv, Sumy, and Kharkiv.

In the western outskirts of Kyiv, a drone strike set a market in Sofiiska Borshchahivka ablaze, killing two people and injuring approximately 10 others.

Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported that nine people were injured in the capital, including a child, after drones hit high-rise apartments, a kindergarten, and a playground.

In the northern city of Sumy, three glide bombs struck near a family support centre, killing two people, while a drone strike in Kharkiv killed a driver in their car.

President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia deployed 277 attack drones since Saturday, including 155 jet-powered drones that are more difficult to intercept.

The attacks also targeted the headquarters of Ukraine's largest mobile service provider and the residence of the Saudi Arabian ambassador in Kyiv.

Russia's defence ministry claimed it struck two data centres in Kyiv and a logistics hub in Odesa, while both nations continue to deny targeting civilians.
